business.summary: HDFCBANK is a financial services institution operating across retail, SME and MSME, and wholesale/corporate banking segments, with retail accounting for 52% of its business. The bank also commands 35% to 40% of account settlements in the Capital Markets segment following its balance sheet expansion post-merger.

promises.promise: Interim Part-Time Chairman appointment approved by RBI for a period of 3 months
promises.delivered: The 3-month interim tenure concluded prior to Q4 FY26 concall with leadership continuity and stability reaffirmed by executive management

promises.promise: Assurance of no material operational issues and complete unity in the management team
promises.delivered: Operational execution continued across subsequent quarters, with FY26 system credit growth reaching 12% and profit before tax rising from Rs 26,961 crore in Dec 2025 to Rs 27,672 crore in Mar 2026

promises.promise: Maintain stable return on assets at 1.9% via core cost efficiencies and lower credit costs despite lower NIMs
promises.delivered: Credit costs remained contained at 44 basis points in Q2 FY27, and Net Profit increased from Rs 21,074 crore in Mar 2026 to Rs 21,537 crore in Sep 2026

promises.promise: Profit growth in the longer term should be at or above balance sheet growth
promises.delivered: Net Profit rose from Rs 20,383 crore in Jun 2026 to Rs 21,537 crore in Sep 2026; long-term assessment remains ongoing

promises.promise: Realize productivity benefits at branches and maintain deposit market share gains
promises.delivered: In Q2 FY27, reported deposits grew 18.8% YoY and retail disbursements increased from Rs 76,000 crores in Q1 FY27 to over Rs 90,000 crores

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: System credit growth picked up with positive momentum in FY26
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated YoY Revenue growth decelerated from +9% in Mar 2025 (Rs 86,779 crore) to +0% in Mar 2026 (Rs 87,182 crore), although Net Profit rose from Rs 19,285 crore in Mar 2025 to Rs 21,074 crore in Mar 2026

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Cost efficiencies supported profitability in Q4 FY26
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Expenses declined from Rs 54,145 crore in Dec 2025 to Rs 44,028 crore in Mar 2026, leading to a rise in Profit before tax from Rs 26,961 crore to Rs 27,672 crore

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Branch productivity continued to move up from past investments in Q1 FY27
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Expenses jumped to Rs 58,292 crore in Jun 2026 from Rs 44,028 crore in Mar 2026, resulting in Financing Profit worsening to -Rs 15,342 crore and Net Profit declining from Rs 21,074 crore to Rs 20,383 crore

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Retail disbursements and liabilities momentum accelerated in Q2 FY27
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Revenue grew from Rs 90,575 crore in Jun 2026 to Rs 95,132 crore in Sep 2026, with YoY growth accelerating from +4% to +9%, and Net Profit rising to Rs 21,537 crore

bull: Net Profit reached Rs 21,537 crore in Sep 2026 with EPS expanding to Rs 13.43 as YoY revenue growth accelerated to +9% (Rs 95,132 crore).
Asset quality is sustained at sound levels with gross NPAs reported at 1.15% in Q4 FY26 and credit costs remaining low at 44 basis points in Q2 FY27.
Retail disbursements accelerated from Rs 76,000 crores in Q1 FY27 to over Rs 90,000 crores in Q2 FY27, backed by 18.8% YoY reported deposit growth.
bear: Financing Profit remained negative at -Rs 5,565 crore in Sep 2026 and -Rs 15,342 crore in Jun 2026, pressured by rising interest expenses of Rs 50,667 crore.

Operating expenses exhibit substantial periodic spikes, reaching Rs 64,497 crore in Jun 2025 and Rs 58,292 crore in Jun 2026, which dragged Net Profit down to Rs 17,090 crore and Rs 20,383 crore in those respective periods.
Consolidated revenue growth decelerated substantially from +59% in Jun 2024 to +0% in Mar 2026, coinciding with management's acknowledgment of a drop in NIMs.
